## Context / Problem
Follow-up (fix b) to creatable-foldable-arthropods (fix a, Gerrit 1761). At SEARCH EXHAUSTION, `BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE` banks `met=false` ("criterion unmet") when the run only established "budget ran out before sufficient evidence was found" — misattributing absence-of-evidence as evidence-of-absence, producing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within the window.

## Proposed fix
Distinguish THREE evidence outcomes: met, refuted, insufficient (search exhausted without a determination) — the third carried as a framework-set `evidence_sufficient:false` marker riding alongside `met:false`, per the verdict_obtainable precedent, so every fail-closed consumer stays unchanged. The marker originates in the banking WRITE path:
- `CompletionEvidencePolicy.fallback_record` (completion_tool_policy.py:100-101) passes a literal `False` through the bool-only record tool. Widen the policy's STRUCTURAL contract: the `fallback_record` Callable signature (:78) gains the marker; completion_banking's wiring supplies a marker-aware bank write. Widens the structural seam, not the model-facing tool; keeps the module's no-completion_banking-import independence (:93-96).
- `CriterionBank.upsert` (completion_banking.py:441-461) — persists the optional marker alongside bool `met` (docstring contract updates).
- `record_criterion_verdict`'s model-facing signature (:539) stays BOOL — the marker is policy-side only, never a model-tool input.
- `harvest_structured_into_bank` (:583) keeps its bool gate but carries the marker through re-harvest instead of dropping it.

**Full consumer graph (all bool-coercing/validating sites change together):**
- **Schema (`src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json`)**: per the `verdict_obtainable` precedent (schema :14-18, completion.py:516) — a marker alongside {PASS, FAIL}, not a third token. Two OPTIONAL framework-set markers: `criteria[].evidence_sufficient:false` (this false is exhaustion, not refutation) and top-level `evidence_sufficient:false` (derived: no criterion genuinely unmet, ≥1 insufficient). verdict/met vocabularies unchanged; only message-rendering consumers read the marker. Both rendering seams validate against this schema (completion_recovery.py:674, :774).
- **`_validate_coverage` (completion_recovery.py:364-368, :717)**: met stays bool → gates unchanged; markers survive validation.
- **`_run_finalizer` (completion_recovery.py:741)**: banked-evidence payload carries the marker so the finalizer sees exhaustion, not refutation.
- **Unbanked/exhausted placeholders** (`assemble_deterministic_verdict` :646-660, `merge_finalizer_with_bank` :715+): a never-banked criterion at exhaustion IS absence-of-evidence — placeholders carry the marker (keeping `exhausted`), not a bare `met:false` + high-severity FAIL finding.
- **`reconcile_verdict` (completion.py:495-564)**: `:522` normalization UNTOUCHED. It DERIVES the top-level marker — as the single chokepoint both verdict kinds pass through (:561), it computes `evidence_sufficient:false` iff no criterion is genuinely unmet (bare met:false) and ≥1 carries the per-criterion marker — and the `:564` remediation branch becomes marker-aware: such a FAIL gets insufficient-evidence remediation, not unmet-criteria guidance. The `:526` verdict_obtainable fault path is unaffected (insufficient criteria still emit findings).
- **Close-gate refusal (close_precheck.py:571-589)**: still gates on non-PASS (fail-closed) — with the marker present it reports "insufficient evidence" + remediation instead of "N unmet criteria".
- **Standalone verb renderer** `_render_verdict_text` (src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:660-693): hard-codes "N unmet criteria" (:672-673) — same marker-aware wording split; exit codes unchanged.
- **Finalizer prompt (completion_verifier_finalizer.md:23-28)**: currently collapses missing/truncated evidence into `met:false` + high-severity finding + FAIL. Update the rule: banked insufficient entries echo as `met:false` with insufficient findings text; `merge_finalizer_with_bank` re-stamps the marker from the bank post-merge (stamp = enforcement, prompt = text alignment).
- **Completion sidecar**: NOT a pass-through where it matters — the FAIL payload (:355-369) whitelist omits `criteria`, and top-level markers ride only via explicit lines (verdict_obtainable :374-375). Add the explicit `evidence_sufficient` line and per-criterion markers to the FAIL payload; round-trip test.
- **Banked-entry rendering** in `assemble_deterministic_verdict` (:619-640) and `merge_finalizer_with_bank` (:705-714): marker-carrying entries emit `met:false + evidence_sufficient:false` with an insufficient-evidence finding, not a bare unmet-criterion FAIL finding. `merge_finalizer_with_bank` is also the authoritative per-criterion RE-STAMP site: the bank (not the model's structured output) is the source of truth for the marker. Its existing-record branch (:700-704) never consults `bank_entries` — add a bank lookup there so the merge overwrites the finalizer's echo (the :705+ fallback already reads the bank). The change is honesty of message and recorded class, never gate leniency.

## Scope
- Banking WRITE path: `fallback_record` contract + wiring (completion_tool_policy.py); completion_banking.py: `upsert` (persists marker), `record_criterion_verdict` (bool signature unchanged), `harvest_structured_into_bank` (markers survive re-harvest), both placeholder branches, `merge_finalizer_with_bank` re-stamp (both branches).
- src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json — optional framework-set `evidence_sufficient:false` markers (top-level + per-criterion), verdict_obtainable pattern; verdict vocabulary unchanged.
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py — `_validate_coverage` markers survive validation; `_run_finalizer` payload carries the marker (:741).
- src/rebar/llm/completion.py — `reconcile_verdict` derives the top-level marker + :564 remediation branch marker-aware.
- src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py — refusal message keys on the marker (insufficient evidence vs unmet criteria); still refuses both.
- src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py — `_render_verdict_text` marker-aware wording (:672-673); exit codes unchanged.
- src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier_finalizer.md — evidence-sufficiency decision rule (:23-28).
- src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py — explicit marker lines + criteria in the FAIL payload; round-trip test.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At search exhaustion, banked fallback evidence carries `evidence_sufficient:false` (never a bare `met=false`); new unit test.
- [ ] A marker-carrying bank entry survives `harvest_structured_into_bank` round-trips; the model-facing `record_criterion_verdict` tool signature remains bool-only; unit tests.
- [ ] A genuine positive refutation still banks `met=false` and still yields FAIL; checked by a guard test.
- [ ] Both rendering seams emit `met:false + evidence_sufficient:false` for insufficient entries, INCLUDING their unbanked/exhausted placeholder branches; per-seam and per-branch tests.
- [ ] Schema validates marker-carrying AND all-bool records; `_validate_coverage` passes markers, still rejects untyped; `_run_finalizer` payload carries the marker; `merge_finalizer_with_bank` re-stamps from the bank over model echoes; FAIL sidecar payload round-trips both marker levels; unit tests each.
- [ ] Close gate still BLOCKS on insufficient evidence (verdict stays FAIL) but the refusal — and `_render_verdict_text`'s standalone output — reports insufficient evidence + remediation, not unmet criteria; `reconcile_verdict` derives the top-level marker and swaps remediation; gate + reconcile + renderer tests.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before close.

## Out of scope
Guard/memo interaction (fix a, landed); retry policy; prompt changes OTHER than the finalizer's evidence-sufficiency rule above.
